title: 6 Killed in Sunset Park Blaze: NYC’s Deadliest Fire This Year
summary: The cause of the fire, at a house in Brooklyn, is not yet clear, but Mayor Zohran Mamdani raised concerns about electric bikes. Fatal fires have soared in New York City this year.
